newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African business confidence index dips in May.
newsitem.headline: S.African business confidence index dips in May.

text.p: The South African Chamber of Business said its business confidence index (1990 = 100) fell by 0.2 percentage points to 113.8 points in May from 114.0 points the previous month and 116.9 a year ago.

Positive influences on the index included a fall in insolvencies, higher share prices, a decline in short-term interest rates and a month-on-month rise in new car sales (although year-on-year car sales fell sharply).
But this was outweighed by a higher rate of inflation, an increase in unemployment, a fall in the dollar gold price and a dcline in the physical volume of manufacturing production.
The index is a composite index which tracks the performance of 13 key economic indicators which have the greatest bearing on the business mood.
